# Parse all habit notes to extract date and habit values
import re

# Define the habit order from the first note (we'll extract from content)
# First, let's parse the first note to get the habit order
first_content = habit_contents[0]['content']
lines = first_content.split('\n')
habits = []
for line in lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
        habit_name = line.split(':')[0].strip()
        habits.append(habit_name)
print("Habit order:", habits)

# Now parse all notes
rows = []
for note in habit_contents:
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
    title = note['title']
    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', title)
    date = date_match.group(1)
    
    # Parse content lines
    content_lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    values = {}
    for line in content_lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            parts = line.split(':', 1)
            habit = parts[0].strip()
            val = parts[1].strip().lower()
            values[habit] = val
    
    # Build row: date + values in habit order
    row = [date] + [values.get(h, 'no') for h in habits]
    rows.append(row)
    print(row)
